task: use a patient portal (MyChart, FollowMyHealth, LabCorp or Quest portals, a health system's own portal): sign in and complete one concrete arc — view test results, read or send a message to the care team, view or download a visit summary or medical record, or check in for an upcoming visit; complete when the result, message, or record is on screen. Surface pinned: the portal itself — not symptom research (healthinfo), not appointment booking (doctor), not pharmacy refills (refill).

tree.label: Use the patient portal
tree.note: do 1 - 1.2 once, on a first invitation (L1Mf); 1.3 thereafter. then 2, and from 2 whichever of 3 to 6 the day's task is - each keeper walks one to three, none walks all four. 7 after any commit: 3.13, 5.9, 5.10.4, and 6.5 all hand into it. 4 gates on 3 at some clinics (CkVD: eCheck-In must complete before joining) and not others (fW6G: abandoned with Finish later, and the visit proceeds). 8 as needed and at the end.
